meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档变成可爱的幻灯片 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把文档快速变成可分享的叙事幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute slide-deck PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly turn a document into shareable narrative slides

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 NotebookLM 把一份文档变成一套 kawaii 风格的 PDF 幻灯片，存放在原文档旁；若分享服务配置齐全，还会额外生成手机版分享链接。
howto.when: 当你说“Wowerpoint <文件>”、“把这份报告做成幻灯片”等，或要求把单个文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.note: 生成一份 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF。

say.text: 把这份市场报告做成幻灯片
say.note: 生成 PDF，配置齐全时还会附上分享链接。
按默认温暖清晰的叙事风格生成。

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii-style PDF slide deck via NotebookLM, saved next to the source file. If the share service is configured, it also produces a mobile-friendly share link.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "Wowerpoint <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.text: Turn this market report into slides.
say_en.note: Generates a PDF, plus a share link if configured.
Uses the default warm and clear narrative style.
